name: Kiro autonomous agent
desc: Kiro's frontier agent mode that carries software work forward unsupervised.
desc_zh: Kiro 的前沿智能体模式，能在无人盯着的情况下持续推进软件开发。
solves: IDE assistants stop when you stop typing; this mode keeps context across hours and finishes the work you delegated.
solves_zh: IDE 助手你一停手它就停；这个模式能跨小时保持上下文，把你派出去的活儿干完。
best_for: You want to delegate a whole migration before leaving for the day and review the pull requests tomorrow.
best_for_zh: 想在下班前把一整个迁移任务派出去，明天再 review 那些 PR 时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — kiro.dev blog feed and product directory）。 Missing from the ledger. Preview from 2025-12-02 for Kiro Pro, Pro+ and Power; from 2026-05-29 it also runs inside Kiro Web as the autonomous mode, which is why kiro.dev/autonomous-agent now redirects to kiro.dev/web. It is a mode of the Kiro surfaces rather than a separate install. 首次公开日期来源：https://kiro.dev/blog/introducing-kiro-autonomous-agent/ 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://kiro.dev/web/）。
